tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page background and both panes of the app (list and editor). Warm off-white, never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed areas on the site: code blocks, a quiet band behind a section. Not used in the app.

tokens.name: tag-row-highlight
tokens.usage: Dark tint behind the active Mac tag-picker row, shared by keyboard and pointer highlighting.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the selected note block, search field, popovers, toolbar group. The only surface that gets a shadow.

tokens.name: math-edit
tokens.usage: Background of a Math block while its LaTeX source is being edited; pair with a line hairline

tokens.name: calendar-heat-empty
tokens.usage: Year calendar tile for a past day without matching notes.

tokens.name: calendar-heat-1
tokens.usage: Calendar heat shade for level one.

tokens.name: calendar-heat-2
tokens.usage: Calendar heat shade for level two.

tokens.name: calendar-heat-3
tokens.usage: Calendar heat shade for level three.

tokens.name: calendar-heat-outlier
tokens.usage: Calendar heat shade for level four.

tokens.name: calendar-heat-outlier-text
tokens.usage: Count text on the level-four calendar heat shade.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: the divider between the note list and the editor, the status bar's top edge, section rules. Decorative only, never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen (a text field with no fill, a secondary button): 3:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text: headlines, note text (list and editor alike), the wordmark, labels. Reads on paper, paper-sunk and sheet (13:1 light, 14:1 dark). Use instead of pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: the lead paragraph, timestamps, waterfall names, nav links, placeholders. Reads on paper, paper-sunk and sheet (5.3:1 light, 6:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative marks only (bullet glyphs, empty-state art). Fails text contrast on purpose; never use for anything a person must read.

tokens.name: weir
tokens.usage: The one interactive colour: primary button fill, links, the caret, focus ring, the active toolbar icon. Text-safe on paper and weir-tint in both themes (5.2:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-weir
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a weir fill (primary button label). Dark in the Night theme because weir lightens there.

tokens.name: weir-tint
tokens.usage: Text selection, search-match highlight, the hover wash on a note block. ink and weir both read on it.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: The app icon's water, exactly. Illustration and large brand fills only (the cover, an empty-state drawing). Never text, never a button: it is 2.7:1 on paper.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: The app icon's weir posts, exactly. Illustration only, always paired with water.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only (delete a note, discard a lens): the label of a danger button and its confirm text. Always with the word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: App mock only: the body of a Liquid Glass control (search field, toolbar group, circular buttons). Always with a backdrop blur.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: App mock only: the bright inner edge along the top of glass controls.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: App mock only: the faint outer edge that separates glass from paper.

tokens.name: mac-close
tokens.usage: App mock only: the red window button, as it renders in the real app.

tokens.name: mac-minimize
tokens.usage: App mock only: the yellow window button.

tokens.name: mac-zoom
tokens.usage: App mock only: the green window button.

tokens.name: note-hover
tokens.usage: Native note-list hover background at base size, without lift or shadow.

tokens.name: note-context
tokens.usage: Stronger native note-list background while an unselected note context menu is open.

tokens.name: tag-clay
tokens.usage: Tag marks and chip symbols; at least 3:1 on paper, paper-sunk and sheet in both themes.

tokens.name: tag-ochre
tokens.usage: Tag marks and chip symbols; at least 3:1 on paper, paper-sunk and sheet in both themes.

tokens.name: tag-moss
tokens.usage: Tag marks and chip symbols; at least 3:1 on paper, paper-sunk and sheet in both themes.

tokens.name: tag-teal
tokens.usage: Tag marks and chip symbols; at least 3:1 on paper, paper-sunk and sheet in both themes.

tokens.name: tag-iris
tokens.usage: Tag marks and chip symbols; at least 3:1 on paper, paper-sunk and sheet in both themes.

tokens.name: tag-plum
tokens.usage: Tag marks and chip symbols; at least 3:1 on paper, paper-sunk and sheet in both themes.

tokens.name: tag-graphite
tokens.usage: Tag marks and chip symbols; at least 3:1 on paper, paper-sunk and sheet in both themes.

tokens.name: shortcut-field
tokens.usage: Solid idle keyboard shortcut recorder field, matching the native-style shortcut references.

tokens.name: shortcut-field-editing
tokens.usage: Inset keyboard shortcut recorder surface while recording; paired with the native focus ring.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The landing hero headline. One per page. ink.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Titles are a tax on thinking.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: One note. New thoughts on top.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the icon in the lockup. Always ink, always title case.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: A weir doesn't stop the river. It gives it a shape.
styles.usage: A person's writing: note blocks, the editor, quotes of user notes on the site.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Weirnote is an opinionated note-taking app with one rule: writing a thought down should cost nothing.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a headline. ink-muted, max 34em wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Notes sink as you add new ones. Nothing is lost; search finds it by meaning.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: App chrome: search field, menus, list metadata.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, the active nav item, waterfall names in the sidebar.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Tags, timestamps, small meta. ink-muted. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: TUI screenshots, CLI and MCP examples, code blocks on paper-sunk.

styles.name: mock-note
styles.sample: Write blog posts why Weirnote is better than Obsidian, Notion, etc.
styles.usage: App mock only: note text in the list and the editor. Same font size selected or not; the selected cell grows by lift-scale instead. ink.

styles.name: mock-ui
styles.usage: App mock only: search placeholder and the status bar. ink-muted.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Use the named steps only; the jumps get bigger as the space gets bigger.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, the gap inside a toolbar group.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between stacked note blocks; between the icon and wordmark in the lockup.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (vertical), gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding (horizontal), note block padding, phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and pane padding; headline to lead paragraph.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Lead paragraph to the call to action.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; hero call to action to the screenshot.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Header to hero headline; between site sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, toolbar buttons, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Note blocks, popovers, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Windows and screenshots of the app, large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The search field and the toolbar group only — the two pill-shaped things in the app.

shadow.note: Site: one shadow, shadow-sheet. App mock: shadow-glass on glass controls, shadow-sheet on the selected note cell.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets that float: the selected note block, the search field, popovers, the app screenshot.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: App mock only: glass controls. The inset line is the rim; the 0.5px ring is the stroke.

tokens.name: shadow-history
tokens.usage: Native History panel only: user-requested subtle outer shadow, drawn outside the inspector clipping boundary without changing its layout.

depth.note: Surface depth and opacity. Timing lives in the README's Motion section.

tokens.name: lift-scale
tokens.usage: Scale of the selected note cell: the whole cell (card and text together) grows by 5% around its centre. Never change the font size instead.
